prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1428; do not mention it.)
text: This letter confirms that our firm now represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Kindly provide, in writing, the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the loss, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage if any, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair estimates, and the claim file in its entirety. Please treat this as a formal demand for preservation. Our client has sustained injuries that are still being evaluated, and we will provide a full accounting of damages once treatment is complete. We look forward to your prompt written response.
